summary: Harden authority checker unhashable guards, RFC6901 mutations, and bounded JSON I/O

delivery.outcome: Eliminate TypeError/RecursionError crashes on unhashable non-scalar grant/profile/object keys, enforce RFC 6901 array indices and non-symlink base paths in apply_invalid_case, fail closed on empty or symlink-containing CLI directories, and harden JSON loading with O_NOFOLLOW 4 MiB regular-file reads, NaN/Infinity rejection, and iterative depth/secret walks while keeping all modules well below 500 lines.
nonGoals: No runtime execution authority or external network calls
No breaking changes to existing valid grant or profile schemas

architecture.decision: Harden load_strict_json, loads_strict_json, closed_object, scan_secrets, and pointer_parent in src/authority_primitives.py and guard unhashable grant/profile fields, binding count/mode types, non-symlink invalid-case base traversal, and directory enumeration in src/authority_check.py.
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-009 commit via governed PR.

validation.evidence: All unit, hardening, and fixture conformance checks pass.
Zero lint findings, GOV-PASS, and wellman standards conformance pass.
